title: Psalms 75
paragraphs: ¹ We give thanks to you, O God; we give thanks, for your name is near. People tell of your wonderful deeds. ² "I choose the appointed time; it is I who judge with equity. ³ When the earth and all its people quake, it is I who hold its pillars firm. Selah. ⁴ To the arrogant I say, 'Stop boasting,' and to the wicked, 'Do not lift up your horn. ⁵ Do not lift your horn against heaven; do not speak with such arrogance.'"

⁶ No one from the east or the west or the desert can exalt themselves. ⁷ It is God who judges: he brings one down and exalts another. ⁸ In the hand of the LORD is a cup full of foaming wine mixed with spices; he pours it out, and all the wicked of the earth drink it down to its very dregs. ⁹ As for me, I will declare this forever; I will sing praises to the God of Jacob. ¹⁰ I will cut off all the horns of the wicked, but the horns of the righteous will be lifted up.
